populations.C1: P0 minus the 65 benign runs whose user task is an injection task (327 benign)
populations.MB: model-balanced: 4 models with >= 50 benign and >= 50 compromised traces (claude excluded); positives weighted to the benign model mix (r4_control.py)
populations.P0F: P0 plus the 4,987 unsuccessful attacks as additional evaluation negatives
populations.WUT_F: within-UT models trained with the unsuccessful attacks of the training folds as negatives
populations.ATTEMPT: exploratory: unsuccessful attacks relabelled as positives (attempt target)

conventions.point: metric on the full population; within-AgentDojo = mean over the 5 CV repetitions; GRU transfer = mean over 3 training seeds; model-balanced = weighted point (positives weighted, ties 1/2)
conventions.primary_interval: 95% cluster bootstrap (plan 3.5), B = 2000, seed 20260927: UT designs resample suite|user_task clusters; IT designs resample positives by suite|injection_task and negatives by suite|user_task; each replicate draws one CV repetition / seed per method
conventions.secondary_interval: v0.3 trajectory-level stratified bootstrap (evalkit.bootstrap mirror), B = 2000, seed 12345; used for the v0.3-vs-corrected comparison (M7) and as a sensitivity
conventions.AP_weighted: prevalence-weighted average precision (plan 3.1): positive weights pi/(1-pi) n_neg/n_pos, APw10 = 10%, APw05 = 5%
conventions.AP_subsample: v0.3 secondary estimator: mean AP over replicates with n_pos = round(pi/(1-pi) n_neg) positives
conventions.thresholds: theta_r80 = 20th percentile of in-sample training-positive scores of each fitted model; no test data used
conventions.rounding: values stored to 4 decimals (some raw floats); r4_deep_summary.md rounds to 3 decimals

reconciliation_with_rerun_v03_scripts.note: metrics compared at the 4 decimals stored by the v0.3 scripts; paired deltas differ by < 1e-4 because the v0.3 scripts store the bootstrap-mean delta of float-noise-tied scores

notes: Corrected LR-B/LR-C values use the method order, seed (12345) and B (2000) of r4_control.py, LR-A those of ablation.py and the GRU those of gru_ladder.py, so their intervals can be compared with the re-run v0.3 scripts (checks_rerun_v03_vs_cache). WIT for LR-A and the GRU, and per-model LR-A/GRU, are new bootstraps (seed 12345).

v0.3 per-model LR-A/GRU and v0.3 WIT LR-A were never computed by the v0.3 scripts; they are recomputed here on archive_v0.3/agentdojo_traces.jsonl with the v0.3 code paths (ablation.fit, gru_detector.train_gru). The GRU was not run under WIT in v0.3.

rule_text.reasonable: AUROC >= 0.80, lower 95% bound of AUROC >= 0.70, AUPRC@10% >= 0.30, lower bound of AUPRC@10% > 0.10
rule_text.near_chance: AUROC CI includes 0.5, or AUROC < 0.60 (one-sided clause written after the transfer AUROC was known, review M6(d); flagged per configuration as near_chance_only_via_below_0.60)
rule_text.plan_procedure: point estimates on the full population (mean over CV repetitions; model-balanced = weighted point), 95% cluster bootstrap (UT: suite|user_task; IT: positives suite|injection_task, negatives suite|user_task), AUPRC@10% = prevalence-weighted AP (plan 3.1)
rule_text.v03_procedure: v0.3 r4_control.py conventions: trajectory-level stratified bootstrap (seed 12345, B = 2000), AUPRC@10% = subsample estimator (mean and 2.5th percentile of AP over replicates with n_pos = round(0.1/0.9 n_neg)); model-balanced AUROC = bootstrap mean
rule_text.C1_transfer: Case A/B also require near-chance transfer on C1 (R4_CONTROL.md says 'the transfer'; P0 and C1 agree for every detector here)

holm_within_minus_transfer_cluster.note: bootstrap p = 2 min(P(d<=0), P(d>=0)); 0 means no replicate on the other side (p < 1/B = 0.0005)

assessment.wording: Outcome 1: strong R1 (GRU AUROC CI lower bound > 0.7), detected degradation R1->R3 in >= 3/5 folds, and near-chance R4 transfer (AUROC CI includes 0.5 or below on P0 and model-balanced)

benchmark.py_73_75: 74:         # No need to run all injection tasks since we don't care about the injection target!
dos_attacks.py_class_header: 11:     """Attack which aims at making the agent stop its current action."""
dos_semantics.reading: For attacks with is_dos_attack = True, AgentDojo runs only the first injection task of the suite (benchmark.py 73-75), so the injection_task id of a DoS run is a placeholder, and it overwrites security with 'not utility' (149-150): a DoS run counts as a successful attack exactly when the user task was NOT completed, whatever the agent did. In all three exception paths (context length, internal server error, server error) the run is scored utility = False, security = True.

positives resampled by suite|user_task|injection_task, negatives by suite|user_task

WUT_GRU_without_unk.note: Exclusion uses each repetition's own fold model vocabulary (cache cov_model < 1): a P0 test trace is excluded when any of its tools is <UNK> for the model that scored it. Point = mean over the 5 repetitions; the bootstrap resamples P0 (stratified, B = 2000, seed 12345) and applies the drawn repetition's exclusion mask; paired contrasts use the same replicate.

criteria_definitions.C1: sign of R3-R1 AUROC identical across the 3 seeds (the criterion GRU_RESULTS.md used)
criteria_definitions.C2: across-seed AUROC range exceeds the mean single-seed 95% bootstrap interval width (B = 1000)
criteria_definitions.C3: across-seed range of FPR or recall at theta_r80 exceeds the mean single-seed 95% interval width
criteria_definitions.C4: across-seed range of FPR or recall at theta_r80 >= 0.10 (absolute)

outcome4.note: GRU_PREREGISTRATION.md does not operationalise 'large seed variance'; C2-C4 are defined here, post hoc.

m15.design: nested CV: outer stratified 5-fold (5 repetitions, shuffle seeds 0-4), inner stratified 5-fold GridSearchCV over C in {1e-3,...,100} (L2 logistic regression, class_weight balanced, StandardScaler), AUROC scoring; bag-of-tools vocabulary built on each outer training fold; point = mean over repetitions of pooled out-of-fold AUROC; 95% stratified bootstrap (B = 2000, one repetition per replicate)

B.note: secondary: mean of the 25 per-outer-fold AUROCs (avoids the downward bias of pooling out-of-fold scores across folds when the signal is weak)

suite.note: secondary: mean of the 25 per-outer-fold AUROCs (avoids the downward bias of pooling out-of-fold scores across folds when the signal is weak)

deviations: R4D1 (seeds of new within-AgentDojo GRU fits). gru_WIT, gru_WUT_F, gru_C1_UT, gru_C1_IT, gru_noDoS_UT and gru_WUT_noUNK follow gru_ladder.py (one training seed per CV repetition: fold seed = training seed = repetition 0-4; gru_ladder.stratified_val(train, repetition)), not the preregistered 3 seeds (same as cache deviation G2).

R4D2 (AUPRC@10% in the Case rule). R4_CONTROL.md Sec. 7 uses 'AUPRC@10%'. The plan procedure uses the plan's prevalence-weighted AP (point, cluster lower bound); the v0.3 procedure uses the v0.3 subsample estimator. Both are reported. For the within-model strata no subsample AP exists, so both procedures use the weighted AP there.
R4D3 (Case A/B transfer condition). 'The transfer is near chance' is applied to both P0 and C1 (the text does not say which population); the conclusion is the same with P0 only for every detector.

R4D4 (near-chance rule). The pre-registered rule (CI includes 0.5, or AUROC < 0.60) is applied literally, including its one-sided '< 0.60' clause (review M6(d)); every configuration flags whether near chance holds only through that clause. Under the ATTEMPT relabelling, transfer AUROCs below 0.5 with intervals excluding 0.5 count as 'near chance' by this rule.
R4D5 (Outcome 4 criteria). GRU_PREREGISTRATION.md does not operationalise 'large seed variance'. Criteria C1-C4 are defined here, post hoc (results m16.outcome4.criteria_definitions).

R4D6 (attempt target, not in the plan). M6 action 6 asks for the Case decision under an 'attempt' target; the ATTEMPT configurations relabel the 4,987 unsuccessful attacks as positives at evaluation only (models unchanged). Exploratory.

R4D7 (model-identity probe design, m15). Nested CV: outer stratified 5-fold x 5 repetitions (shuffle seeds 0-4), inner stratified 5-fold grid over C in {1e-3, 1e-2, 0.1, 1, 10, 100}, L2 logistic regression with class_weight balanced and StandardScaler, inner scoring AUROC; floors = majority (AUROC 0.5) and suite one-hot (the AgentDojo 'domain'). Primary metric = pooled out-of-fold AUROC; fold-mean AUROC is stored as a secondary metric.

R4D8 (model-balanced cluster bootstrap). New: fixed full-pool model-balance weights with suite|user_task (or IT) clusters resampled. The r4_control.py convention (weighted positive draws, bootstrap-mean estimate) is also reported.

R4D9 (m6 exclusion rule). A P0 test trace is 'UNK-bearing' when any of its tools is outside the vocabulary of the fold model that scored it (cache cov_model < 1). The noUNK-train arm removes UNK-bearing traces from the 90% fit partition only; the 10% early-stopping partition is unchanged.

R4D10 (failed-attack flag-rate intervals). Trajectory-level bootstrap and a suite|user_task cluster bootstrap over the 4,987 unsuccessful attacks (94 clusters), B = 2000, seed 4242; one repetition / seed drawn per replicate.

R4D11 (DoS removal). Primary: the 101 DoS positives removed at evaluation (models unchanged). Sensitivity: within-UT models refitted without them (lin_noDoS_UT, gru_noDoS_UT). P0F without DoS also drops the 252 unsuccessful DoS runs.

R4D12 (Q2 design). Per-template transfer within gpt-4o-2024-05-13 uses that model's 92 benign traces as the negatives of every template; trajectory-level stratified intervals. The pooled template-restricted designs add a cluster bootstrap with positives by suite|user_task|injection_task (the review's clustering) and negatives by suite|user_task.

R4D13 (degenerate cluster draws). A cluster replicate that contains no positive or no negative returns NaN and is dropped from the percentiles; this occurs only for the claude-3-5-sonnet stratum (7 positives), which is outside the model-controlled analyses.

R4D14 (v0.3 values the v0.3 scripts never produced). v0.3 per-model LR-A and GRU transfer, and v0.3 WIT LR-A, are recomputed on archive_v0.3/agentdojo_traces.jsonl with the v0.3 code paths (ablation.fit; gru_detector.train_gru refitted deterministically, checked bit-identical against the cache on corrected P0). The GRU was not run under WIT in v0.3.

R4D15 (Holm p-values). Bootstrap two-sided p = 2 min(P(d <= 0), P(d >= 0)); Holm within the five representations of a configuration (plan 3.6 d) and within the 12 within-capable detectors for the all-detector tables.
